abonent_summary.ddl:
CREATE TABLE abonent_summary (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	abonent_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	account_uid VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	account_number VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	fio VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	address VARCHAR(1024) NOT NULL, 
	total_accrued NUMERIC(14, 2), 
	total_paid NUMERIC(14, 2), 
	main_debt NUMERIC(14, 2), 
	penalty_debt NUMERIC(14, 2), 
	total_debt NUMERIC(14, 2), 
	summary_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	summary_reason VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	input_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	dirty_since DATETIME, 
	last_error_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	summary_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

bulk_calc_verify_job_items.ddl:

import_applied_fingerprints.ddl:

import_batches.ddl:

import_rows.ddl:
CREATE TABLE import_rows (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	row_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	excel_sheet_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	excel_row_ref VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	raw_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,

	account_number VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	payment_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	payment_period VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL, 
	charge_year VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL,
